title: Regional healthcare network — 900 synthetic candidates, 6 roles

files.label: Synthetic candidate dataset — 900 rows, 6 clinical/administrative roles, same 20-column schema as synthetic_cvs_hiring.csv
files.license: Synthetic — generated by a seeded script for this example; no real individuals
files.note: Two disparities were deliberately injected: Lab Technician candidates aged 50+ hired at ~0.6x the younger rate, and Hispanic/Latino Clinic Administrator candidates hired at ~0.5x the White rate. Everything else follows one base hire model (experience, referral, GPA).

note: Run against runbook v1.2.0 (size-qualified reference groups). The sandbox received the upload as /app/assets/c31e02a8.00.csv; the Step 1 fallback located it.
